newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Genting to hold 64.8 pct of Genting Plc.
newsitem.headline: Genting to hold 64.8 pct of Genting Plc.

text.p: Malaysia's Genting Bhd said on Wednesday it plans to subscribe for 920 million new shares in Genting International Plc, representing 64.8 percent of the latter's enlarged paid-up capital, for $92 million cash.
The proposed subscription will follow Genting International's restructuring proposal to separate from the Star Cruises Group, Genting said in a statement.

Under the proposed demerger, Star Cruises will cease to be a Genting International subsidiary and will seek approval from the Luxembourg Stock Exchange for its proposed restructuring and listing on that exchange.

This means that Genting International will be downsized and will only hold, among others, properties in Sydney, the right to use the "Genting" name, and a 50 percent equity interest in BML Trust, a trust that owns the project management rights to the second phase of development at the Burswood Resort Casino in Perth, Australia.

Genting International said in a separate statement on Wednesday that since it owned the right to use the "Genting" name and technical know-how for the design management and operations of resort casinos outside Malaysia, it was natural for its existing management to invite Genting to take up a majority stake in Genting International.
Genting International also said that its earnings would be substantially affected from the demerger as Star Cruises would no longer be a subsidiary.
Upon completion of the proposed disposals, demerger and new issue of shares, the net tangible assets of Genting International are expected to be reduced to $0.074 per share from $1.25 currently.
The proposed subscription of the new shares by Genting will also dilute Golden Hope Ltd's shareholding in Genting International to 26 percent from the present 73 percent.
